result: Accepted: QA capture-link, parser, action and account-readback observation preserves the existing behavior and required acceptance gates. Fresh native acceptance remains necessary.
findings: QA-scheme reception records only an exact-match boolean; existing URL acceptance/configuration is unchanged. Differently formatted ingress and parser calls remain distinguishable.
Actual parser receiver, arguments, result identity and thrown error identity are preserved. No raw URL, path, query, route payload or error detail is retained.

The exact capture-only RESET predicate and default action delegation are unchanged. Returned actions retain identity; undefined actions and original failures remain distinct. Action production is never represented as actual dispatch or successful presentation.

Mounted observation records the existing component effect. The same single account-store init call and original result/error/guard behavior remain. Late completion does not substitute for the mandatory visible-heading and saved-account assertions.
No new event listener, timer bootstrap, route registration, provider reset, production code path, assertion, deadline or acceptance exemption is introduced by this trace.
Observation errors are caught without replacing observed state, action, result or error. The bounded recorded fields are primitive diagnostic values; instrumentation still has overhead.
reactReview: The capture component retains its existing effect dependency and cleanup; only a best-effort observation is added.
No conditional hooks, inline component definitions, extra account initialization or render-time side effects are added.

independentValidation.commandMethod: One direct Node execution per selected existing quality file; actual QA entry/setup/account helper with controlled native hosts.
independentValidation.reporterCorrection: The first successful18-case command emitted Node spec output. The collector was corrected to parse that existing output; those tests were not rerun.

separateResponseReview.counting: The disjoint23 response/fixture and30 entry/readback/timer cases cover the same53-case owner suite. Repeated executions are not additional cases.

limits: These controlled tests do not establish native URL delivery, UIKit visibility, physical SecureStore acceptance, a decoded movie or the cause/cure of the f4 iPhone failures.
Trace persistence and bounded retention can omit evidence; a missing marker alone is not proof a phase never entered.
Required native JUnit, fixture, account, media decoder and workflow outcomes remain the acceptance authority.
